mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This appears to be a peeled raw carrot, a non-starchy vegetable with relatively low glycemic impact and fiber that may help moderate blood sugar levels in someone with diabetes. It is generally a suitable choice, though pairing it with protein or another high-fiber food can further support steadier glucose response. It is best to avoid or strictly limit highly processed carbohydrate snacks, opting for whole grain or high-fiber alternatives instead.
mealAnalysis.meal_description: A single peeled raw carrot served plain. This is a simple whole vegetable snack with modest carbohydrate content, low fat, and minimal processing.
